Definition: a Pathrusite, or inhabitant of Pathros
BiblicalUsage: Pathruciy is a Pathrusite, an inhabitant of Pathros. The Pathrusim are named in the genealogy of Ham in Genesis 10:14, among the peoples that came from Mizraim, and again in 1 Chronicles 1:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the nations are named because God keeps track of them all, and the Pathrusim stand in the record beside the peoples whose lands Israel will one day pass through.
